arxiv-2304-10873.title: Moments of inertia in light deformed nuclei: pairing and mean-field impacts
arxiv-2304-10873.creator: V.O. Nesterenko 1,2, M.A. Mardyban 1,2, P.-G. Reinhard 3, A. Repko 4 and J. Kvasil 5
arxiv-2304-10873.description: Abstract The dependence of the moment of inertia 𝒥 \cal J on the pairing and axial quadrupole deformation β \beta in 24 Mg and 20 Ne was investigated. The study is based on quadrupole-constrained calculations with three cranking approaches for 𝒥 \cal J (Inglis-Belyaev, Thouless-Valatin, adiabatic time-dependent Hartree-Fock) and a representative set of Skyrme forces (SVbas, SkM*, SLy6).

arxiv-2402-09359.title: Pruning Sparse Tensor Neural Networks Enables Deep Learning for 3D Ultrasound Localization Microscopy
arxiv-2402-09359.creator: Brice Rauby, Paul Xing, Jonathan Porée, Maxime Gasse, Jean Provost, (Correspondingauthor:JeanProvost.)
arxiv-2402-09359.description: Abstract Ultrasound Localization Microscopy (ULM) is a non-invasive technique that allows for the imaging of micro-vessels in vivo , at depth and with a resolution on the order of ten microns. ULM is based on the sub-resolution localization of individual microbubbles injected in the bloodstream.

arxiv-2403-03341.title: Stabilization of a Nonholonomic Car Model with Off-Hooked Trailers
arxiv-2403-03341.creator: Alexander Zuyev, Victoria Grushkovskaya
arxiv-2403-03341.description: Abstract We consider a kinematic model of a controlled car with two trailers by assuming that each trailer is attached at some distance from the preceding axle (“off-hooked trailers”). For this model, we derive the transformation towards privileged coordinates and present the corresponding nilpotent quasihomogeneous approximate system.

arxiv-2407-00335.title: Journey of X-ray astronomy: Indian perspectives
arxiv-2407-00335.creator: A. R. Rao 1,*
arxiv-2407-00335.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by A. R. Rao 1,*. X-ray astronomy is a mature area of observational astronomy. After the discovery of the first non-solar X-ray source in 1962, X-ray astronomy proliferated during the Apollo era’s space race. Then, it matured as an established area of research during the period of Great Observatories, and now it has become an indispensable tool to understand a wide variety of astrophysical phenomena.

arxiv-2407-07550.title: Evaluating the method reproducibility of deep learning models in the biodiversity domain
arxiv-2407-07550.creator: Waqas Ahmed, Vamsi Krishna Kommineni, Birgitta König-Ries, Jitendra Gaikwad, Luiz Gadelha, Sheeba Samuel, Waqas Ahmed
arxiv-2407-07550.description: Abstract Artificial Intelligence (AI) is revolutionizing biodiversity research by enabling advanced data analysis, species identification, and habitats monitoring, thereby enhancing conservation efforts. Ensuring reproducibility in AI-driven biodiversity research is crucial for fostering transparency, verifying results, and promoting the credibility of ecological findings. This study investigates the reproducibility of deep learning (DL) methods within the biodiversity domain.

arxiv-2504-12604.title: Codes over Finite Ring ℤ k \mathbb{Z}_{k} , MacWilliams Identity and Theta Function
arxiv-2504-12604.creator: Zhiyong Zheng, Fengxia Liu, Kun Tian
arxiv-2504-12604.description: Abstract In this paper, we study linear codes over ℤ k \mathbb{Z}_{k} based on lattices and theta functions. We obtain the complete weight enumerators MacWilliams identity and the symmetrized weight enumerators MacWilliams identity based on the theory of theta function.

arxiv-2507-03326.title: Mirror in the Model: Ad Banner Image Generation via Reflective Multi-LLM and Multi-modal Agents
arxiv-2507-03326.creator: Zhao Wang 1* , Bowen Chen 1,2* , Yotaro Shimose 1* , Sota Moriyama 1,3 , Heng Wang 1 , Shingo Takamatsu 1 1 Sony Group Corporation, Japan 2 The University of Tokyo, Japan 3 The Graduate University for Advanced Studies, Japan
arxiv-2507-03326.description: Abstract Recent generative models such as GPT - 4o have shown strong capabilities in producing high-quality images with accurate text rendering. However, commercial design tasks like advertising banners demand more than visual fidelity—they require structured layouts, precise typography, consistent branding and etc.

arxiv-2507-20075.description: Abstract This paper investigates the optimal control problem for a class of nonlinear fully coupled forward-backward stochastic difference equations (FBS Δ \Delta Es). pmc-11477397.title: The Relationship between Physical Activity and Quality of Life in Postmenopausal Women: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11477397.creator: Maria Tsekoura, Zacharias Dimitriadis, Andreas Gridelas, Argiro Sakellaropoulou, Georgios Kolokithas, Masafumi Koshiyama
pmc-11477397.description: Background: Postmenopausal women frequently encounter a range of symptoms, including fatigue, diminished physical strength, reduced energy levels, vasomotor symptoms such as hot flushes, and vaginal atrophy, all of which adversely affect their overall quality of life. Engaging in physical activity and structured exercise may effectively alleviate these symptoms and enhance overall well-being.

pmc-11662274.description: e modulation of glutamatergic neurotransmission, neuroplastic effects generating long-term changes in synaptic structure and functional connectivity, and effects on cognitive processes such as reward sensitivity. pmc-11667112.title: Framing diagnostic error: an epidemiological perspective
pmc-11667112.creator: Montana Kekaimalu Hunter, Chithra Singareddy, Kenneth A. Mundt
pmc-11667112.description: Diagnostic errors burden the United States healthcare system. Depending on how they are defined, between 40,000 and 4 million cases occur annually. Despite this striking statistic, and the potential benefits epidemiological approaches offer in identifying risk factors for sub-optimal diagnoses, diagnostic error remains an underprioritized epidemiolocal research topic.

pmc-11675977.title: Development and Characterization of Dual-Loaded Niosomal Ion-Sensitive In Situ Gel for Ocular Delivery
pmc-11675977.creator: Viliana Gugleva, Rositsa Mihaylova, Katya Kamenova, Dimitrina Zheleva-Dimitrova, Denitsa Stefanova, Virginia Tzankova, Maya Margaritova Zaharieva, Hristo Najdenski, Aleksander Forys, Barbara Trzebicka, Petar D. Petrov, Denitsa Momekova
pmc-11675977.description: The study investigates the development and characterization of dual-loaded niosomes incorporated into ion-sensitive in situ gel as a potential drug delivery platform for ophthalmic application. Cannabidiol (CBD) and epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG) simultaneously loaded niosomes were prepared via the thin film hydration (TFH) method followed by pulsatile sonication and were subjected to comprehensive physicochemical evaluation.

pmc-11894970.title: Role of innate immunity in SARS-CoV-2 infection
pmc-11894970.creator: Zihao Wang, Fang Cheng, Yuxiu Xu, Xin Li, Songdong Meng
pmc-11894970.description: Highlights•The innate immune is the first line of defense against the severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection.•Aging, obesity, and mental illness can be detrimental to innate immunity.•Nutrition, traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), and heat shock proteins (HSPs) are conducive to innate immunity.•Innate immunity plays a double-edged role in coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) patients.

pmc-12524973.title: Non-Thyroidal Illness Syndrome and Thyroid Autoimmunity in Hospitalized COVID-19 Patients: A Retrospective Study
pmc-12524973.creator: Ewa Kozłowska, Milena Małecka-Giełdowska, Olga Ciepiela
pmc-12524973.description: Background: Thyroid dysfunction, including non-thyroidal illness syndrome (NTIS), is commonly observed in critically ill patients and has been reported in COVID-19, particularly in those with severe disease. NTIS is defined by low free triiodothyronine (fT3) with normal or low thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) and free thyroxine (fT4) levels. Thyroid autoantibodies may also reflect immune system activation.

pmc-12652304.title: Genome-Wide Association Study of First-Parity Reproductive Traits in Suzi Pig
pmc-12652304.creator: Yanfeng Fu, Weining Li, Chaohui Dai, Chao Liao, Jinhua Cheng, Hui Li, Weimin Zhao, Fuping Zhao
pmc-12652304.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Backgrounds: Objective of this study is to conduct a genome-wide association study (GWAS) of first-parity reproductive traits in Suzi pigs to identify significant single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) or candidate genes influencing these traits. Methods: This research employed technologies including the Zhongxin 50K SNP chip, simplified genome sequencing, resequencing, and the 100K SNP liquid chip to perform genome-wide SNP detection on 898 Suzi sows. Genotype data and phenotypic data were combined to do GWAS, gene annotation, and enrichment analysis.

pmc-12661009.title: AIM2 drives inflammatory cell death and monkeypox pathogenesis
pmc-12661009.creator: Jueun Oh, Yun-Ho Hwang, Jihye Lee, Cheong Seok, SuHyeon Oh, Hye Yoon Kim, Nabukenya Mariam, Jaeyoung Ahn, GyeongJu Yu, Jaewoo Park, Hayeon Kim, Suhyun Kim, Seyun Shin, Min-Chul Jung, Jinwoo Gil, Joo Sang Lee, Young Ki Choi, Dokeun Kim, Daesik Kim, You-Jin Kim, SangJoon Lee
pmc-12661009.description: Monkeypox, a zoonotic disease caused by the monkeypox virus (MPXV), has significant global public health implications. Inflammasomes serve as crucial components of the innate immune system, detecting pathogens and triggering cell death in infected cells to eliminate harmful agents. However, the precise molecular mechanisms governing the activation of inflammasomes during MPXV infection remain largely unclear.

pmc-12722555.title: NC CLASP: the structure and reach of a statewide antibiotic stewardship education program
pmc-12722555.creator: Christine E Kistler, Elizabeth S Thomas, Evelyn Cook, Danielle Doughman, Chineme Enyioha, C Adrian Austin, Mallory McClester Brown, Zachary I Willis, James W Johnson, Saif Khairat, Phillip D Sloane
pmc-12722555.description: Experts conducted a free statewide series on antibiotic stewardship for hospital, outpatient, and long-term care settings. In total, 366 participants from 244 sites represented 66% of counties in the state. Furthermore, 62% worked in nonmetropolitan counties, and 55% were from counties with medium-to-high social vulnerability, demonstrating reach into diverse sites.

pmc-13187225.title: How can we improve the timeliness and quality of diagnostic assessment for children with possible autism? Qualitative findings and recommendations from a Realist Evaluation of Autism Service delivery in the United Kingdom
pmc-13187225.creator: Ian Male, William Farr, Sophie McGrevey, Vanessa Abrahamson, Sarah Wigham, Venkat Reddy, Amanda Allard, Victoria Grahame, Jessica Maxwell, Grainne Saunders, Anna Walker, Nic King, Seema Islam, Zamir Akhtar, Jeremy Parr, Patricia Wilson
pmc-13187225.description: Families face long waits for their child to undergo a diagnostic assessment for possible autism. This study explored the experiences of parents and children/young people (CYP) accessing and professionals providing autism diagnostic assessments in the United Kingdom. This realist evaluation was conducted in three phases: (1) interviews and focus groups with parents, CYP and professionals from six U.K.

pmc-13194975.title: Fusing transportation rules and diverse motion behaviors for trajectory prediction in traffic intersections
pmc-13194975.creator: Yuchao Su, Can Pei
pmc-13194975.description: Predicting future trajectories of traffic participants (also called agents) plays an important role in realizing autonomous driving. However, accurately forecasting future trajectories at traffic intersections poses significant challenges. Drivers pay varying attention levels to vehicles in different lanes, and their driving behaviors are influenced by traffic signals.
